recipes.comment: DRAFT coal_batch: 2 iron ingots -> 1 cast-iron ingot, mined coal and longer mixing but better recovery. Low Heated mixing with carbon, then unheated compacting with 250 mB water. Game abstraction, not a metallurgical simulation. Foundry iron first, then basic Create mixer/press and Low Heated basic burner (3 andesite alloy; flint and steel ignition). No Weathered machinery or Blaze required by this draft. Ordinary iron carrier retains appearance; native progress identifies it. TFMG output does not replace the Personal frame literal CBC ingot. Visual review only, no gameplay export. Full survival bootstrap and client acceptance remain unverified.
[Pre-semiconductor ownership] Mechanical components precede final factory assembly.
